      "title": "Historical Crisis Drawdown",
      "body": "In a replay of the 2008–09 financial crisis, the portfolio’s maximum drawdown was $264,672, or 40.3%. That describes a historical scenario, not what will happen in a future downturn. The portfolio is labeled Conservative, while its capacity score is 1 out of 5.",
      "fact_keys": [
        "crash_replays[0].max_drawdown_usd",
        "crash_replays[0].max_drawdown_pct",
        "investor.risk_profile",
        "investor.capacity_1to5"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Projected Fee Costs",
      "body": "Projected fees over 30 years are $204,147, including $151,094 above the 0.05% baseline. The portfolio’s weighted expense ratio is 0.196%.",
      "fact_keys": [
        "fees.projection[2].fees_cost_usd",
        "fees.projection[2].extra_vs_baseline_usd",
        "fees.weighted_expense_ratio_pct",
        "assumptions.fee_baseline_expense_ratio_pct"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Retirement Income Estimate",
      "body": "Across the cautious-to-strong scenarios, the projected balance is $592,885–$592,885, the gap to the target is $201,987–$201,987, and supported income is $57,123–$57,123. These figures assume real returns after fees of 1.8%–5.8%, a 3.9% withdrawal rate, and a 15% reduction to pre-tax accounts. This is a planning estimate, not a guarantee.",
      "fact_keys": [
        "retirement_plan.scenarios[0].projected_at_retirement_usd",
        "retirement_plan.scenarios[2].projected_at_retirement_usd",
        "retirement_plan.scenarios[0].gap_usd",
        "retirement_plan.scenarios[2].gap_usd",
        "retirement_plan.scenarios[0].supported_income_usd",
        "retirement_plan.scenarios[2].supported_income_usd",
        "retirement_plan.scenarios[0].net_return_pct",
        "retirement_plan.scenarios[2].net_return_pct",
        "assumptions.withdrawal_rate_pct",
        "assumptions.pre_tax_accounts_reduced_by_pct"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "advisor_questions": [
    "How should I interpret the historical drawdown replay given my stated risk capacity?",
    "What is included in the fee projection, and how does the baseline comparison work?",
    "How do the retirement estimate’s return, withdrawal-rate, and pre-tax-account assumptions affect its results?"
  ]
